_comment: Dated regulatory claims the site makes, each tied to the primary source it cites. scripts/check_dated_claims.py fetches every source and fails when an anchor sentence is gone (the source changed) or a review date has passed (the source promised an update). Swift blocks non-browser clients, so swift.com is read through the Internet Archive after asking it for a fresh capture.

claims.claim: On 27 August 2026 Swift deferred all payments changes in Standards Release 2026, including the structured-address requirement, and will provide new timing by December 2026.
expect: Swift will defer all payments changes
It will provide an update by December, at the latest
claims.review_note: Swift promised new timing by December 2026 and the homepage ribbon expires on 31 December 2026: re-read the source, update the ribbon and the briefing, and move this date.

claims.claim: Standards Release 2026 would have removed unstructured postal addresses after 14 November 2026 and let corporates keep sending MT101; the page still describes the original plan.
expect: After 14 November 2026, unstructured addresses will be removed
corporates can continue sending MT101 initiation messages
claims.review_note: When Swift publishes the new timing this page will change or be replaced: re-check the sentences the briefing quotes.

claims.claim: The Fedwire Funds Service November 2026 release was rescheduled to November 2027 on 27 August 2026.
claims.review_note: Six months before the rescheduled release: confirm the Fed has not moved it again.

claims.claim: From November 2027 the Bank of England mandates purpose codes on all CHAPS payments.
expect: From November 2027, we are expanding mandatory requirements for Purpose Codes to all CHAPS payments
claims.review_note: Six months before the mandate: confirm the Bank has not revised the policy statement.
